% Template file: do not edit it in a module (see "Template and module files" in README.md).
% Maths macros shipped with the template, used in BOTH the PDF and the HTML output.
% Your own macros go in macros.tex. If macros.tex defines a name that is also here,
% yours is used and the definition here is skipped, so you never need \renewcommand.
%
% One \newcommand per line; lines starting with % are ignored.

% Differentials and derivatives: \dd x, \dv{y}{x}, \dv[2]{y}{x}, \pdv{u}{t}, \pdv[2]{u}{x}
\newcommand{\dd}{\mathrm{d}}
\newcommand{\dv}[3][]{\frac{\mathrm{d}^{#1}#2}{\mathrm{d}#3^{#1}}}
\newcommand{\pdv}[3][]{\frac{\partial^{#1}#2}{\partial #3^{#1}}}
